title: Active Disturbance Rejection Control
text: Design controller for plants with unknown dynamics and disturbances, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Initial conditions} sets Initial state values for extended state observer; {Time domain} sets the controller time domain, {Sample time} sets the controller sample time, {Model type} sets the plant order type, {Critical gain}, {Controller bandwidth (rad/sec)}, {Observer bandwidth (rad/sec)}, {Limit output (u)} limits block output to specified saturation, {Upper limit} sets the upper saturation limit for block output, {Lower limit} sets the lower saturation limit for block output and {Estimated extended states (xhat)} sets the output estimated states from observer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Controller sample time 0.01 (default) | finite positive scalar

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: Initial state values for extended state observer 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Limit output (u)
params.values: Limit block output to specified saturation limits off (default) | on

params.name: Upper limit
params.values: Upper saturation limit for block output inf (default) | scalar

params.name: Lower limit
params.values: Lower saturation limit for block output –inf (default) | scalar

params.name: Estimated extended states (xhat)
params.values: Output estimated states from observer off (default) | on
